yt_posts.engagement_question: Which written off 2024-2025 coin prints a new all time high next?
yt_posts.body:
Last year's meme coins were supposed to be dead. Then the one we 94x'd printed a new all time high...

Every influencer is running the same script right now: the 2024 and 2025 coins are done. Toshi is done. Peanut is done. Pengu is done. Do not touch anything from last cycle. And I get it, it is an easy take, because half the market DOES look like a graveyard.

But here is what actually happened while they were recording those takes. $TUT on BNB, the coin my community publicly called last September and rode for a 94x, went vertical again and printed a NEW all time high on August 9. We are officially at a 130x on the original call. It even flipped Bitcoin on the liquidation charts: over $42 million liquidated in a single day on a so-called dead meme coin from last year.

And the thing is, TUT told you it was coming, if you knew where to look. After the October 10 flash crash it looked absolutely finished: no bounce, no recovery, just one floor that it refused to lose. It sat on that floor for months while everyone forgot about it. Then, after months of silence, new exchange listings suddenly started firing again. That is the reactivation signal. It is the exact same pattern that played out before Pippin ran: written off, then a wave of listings out of nowhere, then an 85x in January. Add the 353x on LAB and the 58x on Velvet, both called in a bear market, and you can see why I take the pattern seriously.

Now the honest part, because I am not a moon boy: some of last year's coins really are dead. Some devs jumped ship the moment things got hard. FUD is free, and sometimes FUD is right. The whole job is separating a held floor and a live team from a ghost chart. That is the difference between a lottery ticket and a shopping list.

So I will ask you the question the influencers will not: which written off 2024 or 2025 coin prints a new all time high next? Drop your pick in the comments, I read all of them.

And if you want the next call while it still looks dead, click that like button and click the subscribe button.

#crypto #memecoins
